title: Degree of an invertible sheaf pulled back along a proper curve map
statement:
Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X,Y$ be proper curves over $k$, meaning separated integral schemes of finite type and dimension one [def-pc-curve], proper over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a dominant $k$-morphism (its image is dense in $Y$), and suppose its induced extension of function fields is finite. Put $d=[k(X):k(Y)]=\dim_{k(Y)}k(X)$ [def-sc-function-field], [def-pc-field-tower]. For every invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module $\mathcal M$ [def-sc-invertible-module], one has
$$\deg_k(f^*\mathcal M)=d\,\deg_k(\mathcal M).$$
Here $f^*$ is module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], and for a line bundle $\mathcal N$ on $Z=X,Y$ the degree is $\deg_k(\mathcal N)=\chi(Z,\mathcal N)-\chi(Z,\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-pc-degree-line-bundle], where $\chi$ is the coherent Euler characteristic [def-pc-euler-characteristic].

source.place: Tag 0AYZ (varieties-lemma-degree-pullback-map-proper-curves), rank-one case; the degree of the morphism is the function-field degree as in morphisms-definition-degree.

proof.text: Put $\mathcal F=f_*\mathcal O_X$ and $d=[k(X):k(Y)]$. Apply [lem-sfb-proper-curve-finite-direct-image-rank] to the given dominant $k$-morphism of proper integral curves and its finite function-field extension. It gives that $f$ is finite, $X,Y$ are locally Noetherian, and $\mathcal O_X$ and $\mathcal F$ are coherent, with $\dim_{k(Y)}\mathcal F_{\eta_Y}=d$.

The invertible $\mathcal M$ is locally free of rank one by [def-sc-invertible-module]. Apply [lem-sfb-finite-map-locally-free-euler-comparison] with $\mathcal E=\mathcal M$ and $\mathcal N=\mathcal O_X$; finiteness and local Noetherianity are Step 1 and properness is a hypothesis. It gives invertibility and coherence of $f^*\mathcal M$, coherence of $\mathcal M\otimes\mathcal F$, and, after the canonical tensor-unit identifications,
$$\chi(X,f^*\mathcal M)=\chi(Y,\mathcal M\otimes\mathcal F),\qquad\chi(X,\mathcal O_X)=\chi(Y,\mathcal F).$$

source.place: Tag 0AYZ, first, second and fourth equalities; projection map is Cohomology Tag 01E8, affine comparison is Cohomology of Schemes Tag 089W.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-trf-curve-euler-tensor-generic-rank] on $Y$ to $\mathcal M$ and $\mathcal F$. The curve is integral, proper and one-dimensional by hypothesis; Step 1 gives coherence and generic rank $d$. Hence
$$\chi(Y,\mathcal M\otimes\mathcal F)=d\deg_k(\mathcal M)+\chi(Y,\mathcal F).$$
Substituting both identities of Step 2 gives $\chi(X,f^*\mathcal M)=d\deg_k(\mathcal M)+\chi(X,\mathcal O_X)$.

source.place: Tag 0AYV, lemma-degree-on-proper-curve, rank-one case; third equality in Tag 0AYZ.

proof.text: Subtract $\chi(X,\mathcal O_X)$ from Step 3. The definition [def-pc-degree-line-bundle] identifies the difference on the left with $\deg_k(f^*\mathcal M)$, giving $\deg_k(f^*\mathcal M)=d\deg_k(\mathcal M)$.

source.place: Tag 0AYR, definition-degree-invertible-sheaf; final subtraction in Tag 0AYZ.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0AYZ (lemma-degree-pullback-map-proper-curves), proof in the rank-one case, with its finite-map and generic-stalk inputs made explicit.
